description: A CR that is not followed by LF is rejected inside a quoted string
notes: The spec defines the newline sequences as LF and CR LF, and quoted templates only forbid literal newline sequences, so a lone CR should be an ordinary character with the value "x\ry". The reference scanner treats CR like LF inside quoted strings (NewlineChars in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl), and checkInvalidTokens in token.go reports the TokenQuotedNewline.
